subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & discounts (startup + committed use) — NovaLabs
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily@novalabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Pricing & discounts (startup + committed use) — NovaLabs

Hi Emily / Noah — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we’re all aligned.

Recap of expected usage (from our convo):
- Baseline generation + embeddings: ~3–5M tokens/month initially, trending to 10–12M in Q4 with product launch.
- Peak burst expectations: up to ~1.5–2M tokens/day during spikes.
- Latency SLO: 95th < 600ms for single-turn generation; embeddings are less sensitive.

Pricing targets you mentioned:
- Target unit economics: ~$500–700 per 1M tokens (goal for runway + low CPx).
- Budget range: ~$2k–8k/month in year 1 depending on growth trajectory and discounts.

What Redwood can offer (high level):
- Hosted API with startup program: up to 40% off list for qualifying startups (12 months).
- Committed-use (12-month) discount: additional 15–25% depending on commit size (sliding scale).
- Multi-year incentives: potential bump for 24-month commitments (additional ~10% credits).

Requested from you:
1) Confirm a realistic 12-month usage forecast (I attached the quick template). If you can fill the Q2–Q4 columns we’ll run precise unit economics.
2) Indicate your preference for term length: month-to-month vs 12m committed vs 24m.
3) Any procurement constraints (PO process, legal redlines, SOC 2 evidence) we should prep for.

I attached a preliminary pricing proposal and a blank usage forecast (redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf, usage-forecast.xlsx). If the numbers look okay I’ll pull Marissa & Aditya in to draft a concrete proposal (commit tiers + exact $/1M after discounts).

Next step: can we aim for a quick follow-up on Friday to finalize commit size?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachment: redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf (pricing summary)
Attachment: usage-forecast.xlsx (please complete)

From: Emily Chen <emily@novalabs.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & discounts (startup + committed use) — NovaLabs

Thanks Ben — great summary. Quick answers from our side: 

- Confirmed volumes: we expect 4–6M tokens/mo for the next 3 months, hitting 9–12M/mo by Q4 if product launch goes as planned.
- Target $/1M tokens: our CFO would like to see $550–650/1M tokens (this is our stretch target; $700 max).
- Budget: we can commit to ~$5k–7k/mo year 1 if we can get a meaningful startup discount + a 12m committed reduction.
- Term preference: leaning towards 12m committed if the effective $/1M lands in the target range.

Procurement: we need standard SOC 2 and some basic data handling confirmation (no PII persists beyond session). We can share our procurement checklist — I’ll send separately.

I’ll fill the usage-forecast and send back by EOD Thursday. If you can put numbers on the effective $/1M after discounts (startup + 12m commit), that’ll help our budgeting.

Best,
Emily
Head of Product | NovaLabs
emily@novalabs.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & discounts (startup + committed use) — NovaLabs

Ben — copying in Aditya for approval and to confirm program terms. Draft proposal based on Emily’s forecast: 4–6M initial, mid-year 9–12M.

Assumptions (list price for hosted text generation): $1,200 / 1M tokens (example list; internal).
Discount stack possibilities we can offer:
- Startup program (verified): 40% off list for 12 months => effective $720/1M.
- Committed-use 12m (tier dependent): additional 20% off post-startup price for a 12m commit at >= $50k ARR committed => effective $576/1M.
- Multi-year (24m): add’l 10% credit applied as billing credits (effective additional ~10% improvement over 12m).

Example math for Emily’s ask (target $550–650):
- With startup 40%: $1,200 * 0.60 = $720/1M (still above their $650 ceiling).
- With startup + 12m commit (20%): $720 * 0.80 = $576/1M — within their target band.
- If we add a 24m incentive (10%): $576 * 0.90 = $518/1M — below stretch target (very attractive).

Recommended next steps:
1) Ben to confirm NovaLabs’ preferred commit band (12m dollar amount / expected annual spend). If they can commit to ~$60k–80k ARR we can land ~20% commit discount.
2) If they want to preserve cash, propose 12m with payment monthly; legal can add minimal language for renewal.
3) We’ll prepare an official quote and DocuSign for signature (I’ll include pricing table with effective $/1M and estimated monthly spend for their forecast).

Aditya — ok to approve the 20% commit band for RDW-4239? If not, proposed escalation path?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachment: internal-commit-tier-grid.pdf (internal reference)

Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround and for filling the forecast. Based on Marissa’s note here’s what we can do for NovaLabs: 

Offer summary (hosted API, generation + embeddings):
- Startup program (12 months): 40% off list.
- 12-month committed-use: additional 20% off post-startup price for commit >= $60k ARR.
- Effective price at $60k ARR commit: $576 / 1M tokens.
- 24-month incentive: additional 10% credit (effective ~ $518 / 1M).

Estimated monthly cost (based on your Q2–Q4 forecast you sent):
- Q2 average (4.5M/mo): ~ $2.6k/mo at $576/1M.
- Q4 ramp (10M/mo): ~ $5.76k/mo at $576/1M.

Next steps:
1) If you confirm the $60k ARR 12m commit, I’ll send an official quote (DocuSign link) and toggle the startup program verification flow.
2) We’ll include SOC 2 evidence pack in the DocuSign package and a short data handling addendum (no PII persistence clause).
3) Target to have the signed agreement and first-month billing set up by May 10 so you’re ready for the launch.
